module.name: Project Bubble Gum
module.summary: Foundational research module for non-classical transport, continuity-preserving transfer pathways, resonance-aligned channels, and early transporter-class technologies.
module.purpose: Provide the structural, conceptual, and computational substrate for open research into continuity-preserving transport systems. Defines transport operators, multi-regime pipelines, resonance-bridge models, and RTT-aligned safety frameworks.
